name: Ayesha Raza Mishra
bio: A prolific theater artist Ayesha Raza Mishra is seldom seen working in movies. Since two of her grand-aunts were theater actors, Ayesha had always been exposed to theater. She soon took to performing on stage after training under the guidance of Amal and Nissar Allana at the Dramatic Art and Design Academy in New Delhi. She has also been a part of two very popular YouTube web series Permanent Roommates and Bang Baaja Baarat. With several plays to her credit, Ayesha has also appeared in movies such as Dhoom, Happy Bhaag Jayegi, Dil Dhadakne Do, Befikre, Toilet - EK Prem Katha and Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety.
